name: inbox-warden
description: Let Claude search, read, sort and draft your email: Gmail, GMX, Web.de, IONOS, iCloud or your own mail server.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your mailbox over IMAP and SMTP.

**Safe by default:** Claude searches, reads, sorts and writes drafts; you send them. Sending and moving mail to the Trash stay off until you switch them on, and nothing is ever deleted permanently.

**Locked folders** (for example mail under an NDA) are invisible to Claude, with all their subfolders.

Gmail, iCloud and Yahoo need an app password. Several mailboxes, Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace sign-in: set them up once with the command-line version and leave the email address empty (see Documentation).

email.title: Email address (leave empty for mailboxes from setup)
email.description: The mailbox Claude may use, e.g. office@your-company.at. Leave it empty to use every mailbox set up with the command-line version (inbox-warden setup); the password, name and Advanced fields are then not used, and the two switches and the locked folders apply to every mailbox.

password.title: Password (Gmail: app password)
password.description: Gmail, Yahoo and iCloud require an app password (see the guide). Stored encrypted by Claude Desktop, never in a file.

display_name.title: Your name (optional)
display_name.description: Shown to recipients as the sender, e.g. Maximilian Achleitner.

allow_send.title: Claude may send email
allow_send.description: Off: Claude only writes drafts and you send them. On: Claude may send; Claude asks for your approval before each email.

allow_delete.title: Claude may move email to Trash
allow_delete.description: Moves email into the Trash only. Nothing is ever deleted permanently; you empty the Trash yourself.

locked_folders.title: Locked folders (comma-separated)
locked_folders.description: Folders Claude must not see, e.g. for mail under an NDA. Separate names with commas: _NDA_Inbox, _NDA_Project. The name alone is enough, wherever the folder is; subfolders are locked too. Wildcards work: _NDA_* locks every folder starting with _NDA_. A name that contains a comma: write ? in place of the comma.

attachment_dirs.title: Attachment folders (optional)
attachment_dirs.description: Claude can attach files to drafts only from these folders (and their subfolders). Leave empty to switch file attachments off.

download_dir.title: Download folder (optional)
download_dir.description: Claude saves email attachments only into this folder. Leave empty to switch saving off.

imap_host.title: Advanced: incoming server (IMAP)
imap_host.description: Leave empty to detect it from your address. Own or unusual provider: imap.example.com, or with a port imap.example.com:143 (default 993).

smtp_host.title: Advanced: outgoing server (SMTP)
smtp_host.description: Leave empty to detect it from your address. Own or unusual provider: smtp.example.com, or with a port smtp.example.com:587 (default 465).

username.title: Advanced: login name, if different
username.description: Leave empty when you log in with your email address (almost all providers).

skip_server_lookup.title: Advanced: don't look up servers online
skip_server_lookup.description: Gmail, GMX, iCloud and other well-known providers still work. Other addresses then need both servers above.
